papers.title: High-Penetrance and Polygenic Germline Determinants of Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer: Insights From a Prospective Cohort
papers.authors: Rivera H, Morón-Duran F, García J, Marín R, Pérez-García J, Ramos-Muntada M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The genetic basis of early-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) extends beyond established hereditary cancer syndromes, yet the contributions of rare high-penetrance variants, polygenic risk, and inherited immune-related genetic variation remain incompletely defined in prospectively recruited EOCRC patients. We evaluated monogenic and polygenic germline determinants of EOCRC as well as immune-related variants in an exploratory analysis, in a prospective cohort.
METHODS: We analyzed 101 prospectively recruited, consecutive EOCRC patients from the Spanish Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Consortium (SECOC), an unselected multicenter cohort. Exome sequencing was used to identify pathogenic or likely pathogenic germline variants in established hereditary cancer genes and candidate genes implicated in hereditary colorectal cancer (CRC)-related pathways. Polygenic risk was assessed in 72 genetically unresolved EOCRC patients using 203 established CRC risk alleles and compared with 1003 patients with CRC diagnosed at age ≥ 50 years and 1642 controls. An exploratory analysis of 47 immune-related CRC risk alleles was also performed.
RESULTS: Pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in established hereditary cancer genes were identified in 14% of EOCRC patients, predominantly affecting DNA mismatch repair genes. No convincing novel susceptibility genes were identified. Among genetically unresolved patients, approximately 15% had a polygenic risk above the 95th percentile of controls, a proportion comparable to that observed in patients with CRC diagnosed at age ≥ 50 years. In the exploratory immune-related analysis, no evidence of enrichment of immune-related risk alleles was observed in EOCRC.
CONCLUSIONS: EOCRC has a complex germline genetic architecture encompassing both established high-penetrance predisposition genes and polygenic susceptibility. Approximately one in seven patients carried a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in an established CRC predisposition gene, while a further subset of genetically unresolved patients had high polygenic risk, highlighting the substantial contribution of inherited genetic susceptibility to EOCRC.

papers.title_zh: 早發型大腸直腸癌的高外顯率與多基因生殖系決定因子：前瞻性世代研究的啟示
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：早發型大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）的遺傳基礎不僅限於已確立的遺傳性癌症症候群；然而，在前瞻性招募的EOCRC病人中，罕見高外顯率變異、多基因風險及遺傳性免疫相關基因變異的貢獻，仍未完全釐清。我們在一個前瞻性世代中，評估EOCRC的單基因與多基因生殖系決定因子，並以探索性分析評估免疫相關變異。
方法：我們分析西班牙早發型大腸直腸癌聯盟（SECOC）前瞻性、連續招募的101名EOCRC病人；此為未經篩選的多中心世代。研究使用外顯子定序，辨識已確立的遺傳性癌症基因，以及涉及遺傳性大腸直腸癌（CRC）相關路徑之候選基因中的致病或可能致病生殖系變異。在72名尚未釐清遺傳病因的EOCRC病人中，使用203個已確立的CRC風險等位基因評估多基因風險，並與1003名診斷年齡≥50歲的CRC病人及1642名對照者比較。此外，也針對47個免疫相關CRC風險等位基因進行探索性分析。
結果：14%的EOCRC病人在已確立的遺傳性癌症基因中帶有致病或可能致病變異，主要涉及DNA錯配修復基因。未發現具有充分說服力的新易感基因。在尚未釐清遺傳病因的病人中，約15%的多基因風險高於對照組的第95百分位數，此比例與診斷年齡≥50歲的CRC病人相近。在探索性的免疫相關分析中，未觀察到EOCRC有免疫相關風險等位基因富集的證據。
結論：EOCRC具有複雜的生殖系遺傳架構，涵蓋已確立的高外顯率易感基因與多基因易感性。約每七名病人就有一名在已確立的CRC易感基因中帶有致病或可能致病變異，而尚未釐清遺傳病因的病人中，另有一部分具有高多基因風險，凸顯遺傳易感性對EOCRC的重要貢獻。
papers.score_reason: 前瞻性、連續收案的未篩選多中心隊列，有助評估EOCRC遺傳變異的分布，但樣本僅101人，且未提供效應量或信賴區間。值得關注遺傳評估者閱讀，但不足以支持台灣常規導入多基因風險評分。
papers.relevance_why: 直接涉及早發CRC病人的遺傳評估與諮詢，但多基因風險結果對台灣族群的適用性仍待驗證。
papers.one_liner: 在101名早發CRC中分析遺傳變異，並與較晚發CRC及對照比較，約15%未解病例具高多基因風險。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；早發CRC持續安排遺傳評估，勿據此將多基因風險評分納入常規。

pico.P: 西班牙SECOC未經篩選、前瞻性連續招募的101名EOCRC病人；其中72名遺傳病因未明者接受多基因風險分析。
pico.I: 外顯子定序辨識致病或可能致病生殖系變異；以203個CRC風險等位基因評估多基因風險，並探索47個免疫相關風險等位基因。

72名遺傳病因未明者，約15%風險高於對照第95百分位。

papers.context: 相較於前兩篇EOCRC綜述，本研究補上前瞻性收案的原始資料，量化已知高外顯率變異與高多基因風險的分布。相較於283名疑似遺傳性CRC的院內基因檢測研究，本篇聚焦未經篩選的EOCRC並加入多基因分析；兩者收案條件不同，不宜直接比較檢出率。

papers.title: Validation of Newcastle ENDOPREM for assessing patient experience with colonoscopy: a multicenter prospective study
papers.authors: Liu B, Yang K, Shu H, Li X, Jiang Y, Luo S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patient experience is a key quality indicator for colonoscopy, yet standardized assessment tools are lacking in China. The Newcastle ENDOPREM scale has shown promise internationally but requires validation in China.
OBJECTIVE: To translate, adapt, and preliminarily evaluate the psychometric properties of the Chinese version of the Newcastle ENDOPREM (ENDOPREM-CN) to assess colonoscopy patient experience in Chinese patients.
METHOD: This dual-center prospective study followed forward-backward translation principles and cognitive interviewing for adaptation. From April 2024 to April 2026, 296 patients undergoing colonoscopy completed the ENDOPREM-CN. Reliability and validity were assessed, and factors influencing experience were analyzed.
RESULTS: Of 301 patients, 296 completed the ENDOPREM-CN. Positive experience was high (98.3%). Phase-specific findings showed 64.2% pre-procedure anxiety, 70.6% unpleasant bowel preparation taste, and, in terms of the post-procedure, 40.9% discomfort and 67.6% result concern. Total scale reliability was good (Cronbach's α = 0.86, KMO = 0.83); phase reliability ranged from excellent (before test, α = 0.93) to poor (bowel preparation, α = 0.41). Multivariate regression analysis identified factors including adequate information provision and anxiety about abnormal results (both P < 0.01) before the test, better-than-expected bowel preparation taste (P < 0.01), endoscopist gender preference (P = 0.05) and explanation about the procedure perceived right to terminate, embarrassment, discomfort frequency during the test (all P < 0.01), explanation of the results and clarity on next steps (both P < 0.01) after the test were associated with overall experience.
CONCLUSIONS: The ENDOPREM-CN shows acceptable overall reliability for measuring Chinese colonoscopy patients' experiences. Our findings underscore the importance of better patient communication, respecting patients' right to terminate procedures, and clear post-procedure results and follow-up to improve patient experience.
papers.title_zh: Newcastle ENDOPREM 用於評估大腸鏡病人體驗之驗證：多中心前瞻性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：病人體驗是大腸鏡檢查的重要品質指標，但中國目前缺乏標準化評估工具。Newcastle ENDOPREM 量表在國際上已展現潛力，但仍需在中國進行驗證。
目的：翻譯、調適並初步評估中文版 Newcastle ENDOPREM（ENDOPREM-CN）的心理計量特性，以評估中國病人的大腸鏡檢查體驗。
方法：本雙中心前瞻性研究依循正向與反向翻譯原則，並透過認知訪談進行調適。2024年4月至2026年4月期間，296名接受大腸鏡檢查的病人完成 ENDOPREM-CN。研究評估其信度與效度，並分析影響病人體驗的因素。
結果：301名病人中，296名完成 ENDOPREM-CN。正向體驗比例很高（98.3%）。各階段結果顯示，64.2%有檢查前焦慮，70.6%認為腸道準備劑味道不佳；檢查後則有40.9%感到不適，67.6%擔心檢查結果。整體量表信度良好（Cronbach's α＝0.86，KMO＝0.83）；各階段信度則從極佳（檢查前，α＝0.93）到不佳（腸道準備，α＝0.41）不等。多變項迴歸分析發現，與整體體驗相關的因素包括：檢查前獲得充分資訊及對異常結果的焦慮（兩者皆 P＜0.01）；腸道準備劑味道比預期好（P＜0.01）；內視鏡醫師性別偏好（P＝0.05），以及檢查過程中的程序說明、感受到的終止檢查權利、尷尬感與不適頻率（皆 P＜0.01）；檢查後的結果說明及對後續步驟的清楚了解（兩者皆 P＜0.01）。
結論：ENDOPREM-CN 用於測量中國大腸鏡病人體驗時，展現可接受的整體信度。本研究結果凸顯，改善醫病溝通、尊重病人終止檢查的權利，以及清楚說明檢查後結果與追蹤安排，對改善病人體驗的重要性。
papers.score_reason: 雙中心前瞻性心理計量驗證對大腸鏡品質管理具參考價值，但整體信度不能代表所有分量表皆可靠。摘要未提供完整效度結果或迴歸效應量，且仍需台灣在地驗證。
papers.relevance_why: 直接涉及大腸鏡病人體驗與品質管理，但並非治療效果研究，且中國版量表不能直接視為已適用台灣。
papers.one_liner: 在296名大腸鏡受檢者中，無對照驗證ENDOPREM-CN，整體信度α＝0.86。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；用於台灣大腸鏡受檢者前，先完成繁中調適與在地驗證。

pico.P: 中國兩中心接受大腸鏡檢查的301名病人，其中296名完成問卷。
pico.I: 經正反向翻譯及認知訪談調適的ENDOPREM-CN病人體驗量表。
pico.O: 量表信度與效度；各檢查階段的病人體驗及與整體體驗相關的因素。摘要未明確區分主要與次要結果。

key_numbers: 301人中296人完成問卷；整體正向體驗98.3%。
整體α＝0.86；檢查前α＝0.93，腸道準備α＝0.41。
檢查前焦慮64.2%；準備劑味道不佳70.6%。
cautions: 正向體驗達98.3%，提示天花板效應，可能難區分服務品質差異。
腸道準備分量表α僅0.41；KMO不等於信度，亦不能取代效度驗證。
迴歸僅報P值，缺效應量與信賴區間；相關性不能證明改善溝通有效。

鎮靜方式、檢查適應症與兩中心病人組成

papers.title: When surgery unmasks the typhoid fever epidemic in Niger: a multicentre retrospective cohort study of 2,931 ileal perforations (2014-2019)
papers.authors: Bara A, Magagi M, Mahaman M, Maman B, Fils S, Bagnou H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Typhoid fever remains a major public health challenge in low-income countries, where surgical complications particularly ileal perforation account for the greatest share of associated mortality. In Niger, restricted access to bacteriological investigations leads to substantial under recognition of the true disease burden.
OBJECTIVES: To describe the epidemiological, clinical, therapeutic, and outcome characteristics of presumed typhoid ileal perforations managed surgically in two referral hospitals in Niger, and to identify factors independently associated with in-hospital mortality.
METHODS: A multicentre retrospective descriptive study was conducted at the Zinder National Hospital (ZNH) and the Maradi Regional Hospital Centre (RHC/M) between January 2014 and December 2019. All patients who underwent surgery for acute peritonitis secondary to presumed typhoid ileal perforation, defined on the basis of epidemiological, clinical, and intraoperative criteria, were included. Factors associated with in-hospital mortality were identified by multivariate logistic regression.
RESULTS: A total of 2,931 cases of presumed typhoid ileal perforation were recorded among 4,271 operated acute peritonitis cases (68.6%). The mean age was 14.4 ± 11.2 years, with children and adolescents (1-15 years) representing 72.1% of cases. The male-to-female ratio was 1.8. Most patients came from rural areas (67.4%), and 71.3% were classified as indigent. The mean time from symptom onset to admission was 114.8 ± 62.2 h. Diverting ileostomy was the most frequently performed procedure (61.3%). Overall in-hospital case fatality was 11.2% (328/2,931). On multivariate analysis, rural origin (adjusted OR = 1.47; 95% CI: 1.13-1.86; p = 0.021) and indigent status (adjusted OR = 1.66; 95% CI: 1.21-2.07; p = 0.002) were independently associated with mortality.
CONCLUSION: Typhoid ileal perforations represent a substantial surgical burden in Niger, predominantly affecting children and socioeconomically disadvantaged populations. Strengthening early diagnosis, expanding vaccine coverage notably through the recent introduction of the typhoid conjugate vaccine (TCV) into Niger's Expanded Programme on Immunisation (EPI) and improving access to emergency surgical care are public health priorities.
papers.title_zh: 當外科手術揭露尼日傷寒疫情：2,931例迴腸穿孔的多中心回溯性世代研究（2014–2019）
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：傷寒仍是低收入國家的重大公共衛生挑戰，其中外科併發症，尤其是迴腸穿孔，占相關死亡的最大比例。在尼日，細菌學檢查的可近性受限，導致真實疾病負擔被嚴重低估。
目的：描述尼日兩家轉診醫院接受手術治療之疑似傷寒性迴腸穿孔患者的流行病學、臨床、治療及預後特徵，並辨識與住院死亡獨立相關的因素。
方法：於津德爾國家醫院（ZNH）及馬拉迪區域醫院中心（RHC/M），針對2014年1月至2019年12月進行多中心回溯性描述研究。納入所有因疑似傷寒性迴腸穿孔繼發急性腹膜炎而接受手術的患者；疑似傷寒性迴腸穿孔依流行病學、臨床及術中標準定義。以多變項邏輯斯迴歸辨識與住院死亡相關的因素。
結果：4,271例接受手術的急性腹膜炎病例中，共記錄2,931例疑似傷寒性迴腸穿孔（68.6%）。平均年齡為14.4 ± 11.2歲，兒童及青少年（1–15歲）占72.1%。男女比為1.8。多數患者來自農村地區（67.4%），71.3%被歸類為貧困者。從症狀出現至入院的平均時間為114.8 ± 62.2小時。轉流性迴腸造口術是最常施行的術式（61.3%）。整體住院病死率為11.2%（328/2,931）。多變項分析顯示，來自農村（校正後OR＝1.47；95% CI：1.13–1.86；p＝0.021）及貧困身分（校正後OR＝1.66；95% CI：1.21–2.07；p＝0.002）均與死亡獨立相關。
結論：傷寒性迴腸穿孔在尼日造成重大外科負擔，主要影響兒童及社會經濟弱勢族群。強化早期診斷、擴大疫苗涵蓋率，尤其透過近期將傷寒結合型疫苗（TCV）納入尼日擴大免疫接種計畫（EPI），以及改善緊急外科照護的可近性，均為公共衛生優先事項。
papers.score_reason: 兩院2,931例提供具規模的區域外科負擔資料，但病因依臨床推定，死亡相關因素也可能受殘餘混雜影響。對台灣常規大腸直腸外科實務的直接適用性有限，較適合感染性急腹症或全球外科工作者閱讀。
papers.relevance_why: 研究以尼日兒童及青少年的疑似傷寒性穿孔為主，疾病盛行程度與醫療可近性均與台灣差異甚大。
papers.one_liner: 在2,931例疑似傷寒穿孔中，比較農村與非農村患者，發現農村者住院死亡勝算較高（校正OR 1.47）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；此為尼日疑似傷寒穿孔的觀察資料，不能據此調整台灣穿孔患者的術式。

pico.P: 尼日兩家轉診醫院2014–2019年間，因疑似傷寒性迴腸穿孔繼發急性腹膜炎而接受手術的2,931例患者。
pico.I: 農村來源、貧困身分等人口與社會經濟暴露；非治療介入試驗。

papers.title: Expanding minimally invasive options in emergency general surgery: a multicentre evaluation of a novel MIS platform
papers.journal_full: European journal of trauma and emergency surgery : official publication of the European Trauma Society
papers.authors: Cadière B, Mercoli H, Keller D
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Emergency general surgery (EGS) carries elevated morbidity, and minimally invasive surgery (MIS) may reduce surgical trauma but remains limited by staffing, logistical, and technical barriers. The Maestro® Platform is a collaborative robotic system designed to enhance surgeon autonomy during MIS. This study compares Maestro-assisted versus conventional laparoscopic EGS, stratified by procedure type.
METHODS: This multicentre retrospective study compared 24 Maestro-assisted EGS cases (July 2024-April 2025) with 25 consecutive conventional laparoscopic cases performed by the same surgical team. Outcomes analysed included surgery time, conversion rate, postoperative complications, length of stay, and 30-day mortality. Analysis was stratified by procedure type: appendectomy, emergency colectomy, and small bowel obstruction surgery. Additional Maestro cases without baseline comparators were reported descriptively.
RESULTS: Within comparable procedure groups, Maestro-assisted cases showed shorter surgery times: appendectomy (33.5 [31.5-42.3] vs. 76.0 [70.0-81.0] min, p = 0.002), emergency colectomy (135.0 [122.0-165.0] vs. 197.5 [159.3-220.0] min, p = 0.08), and small bowel obstruction (107.0 [28.0-110.0] vs. 108.0 [90.8-127.5] min, p = 0.54). No Maestro cases required conversion to open surgery, compared with 3 of 25 baseline cases (12%). Complication rates and length of stay were similar between groups. No device-related adverse events occurred.
CONCLUSION: In this preliminary procedure-stratified analysis, Maestro-assisted EGS was associated with shorter surgery times and a trend toward shorter length of stay and lower conversion rates in complex procedures such as colectomy, while maintaining comparable safety outcomes. The platform appeared adaptable across diverse emergency indications and may support minimally invasive approaches in emergency settings. Larger, prospective studies will be necessary to confirm these observations and define the role of collaborative robotic platforms in emergency surgical care.

papers.title_zh: 拓展急診一般外科的微創選項：新型 MIS 平台的多中心評估
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：急診一般外科手術（EGS）的併發症風險較高，微創手術（MIS）可能減少手術創傷，但仍受到人力、作業安排與技術障礙的限制。Maestro® 平台是一套協作式機器人系統，旨在提升外科醫師於 MIS 過程中的自主性。本研究依手術類型分層，比較 Maestro 輔助與傳統腹腔鏡 EGS。
方法：這項多中心回溯性研究比較了24例 Maestro 輔助 EGS（2024年7月至2025年4月），以及由同一手術團隊執行的25例連續傳統腹腔鏡手術。分析結果包括手術時間、轉開腹率、術後併發症、住院天數及30天死亡率。分析依手術類型分層：闌尾切除、急診結腸切除及小腸阻塞手術。另以描述性方式呈現沒有基準對照病例的其他 Maestro 手術病例。
結果：在可比較的手術組別中，Maestro 輔助手術的手術時間較短：闌尾切除為33.5［31.5–42.3］對76.0［70.0–81.0］分鐘，p＝0.002；急診結腸切除為135.0［122.0–165.0］對197.5［159.3–220.0］分鐘，p＝0.08；小腸阻塞手術為107.0［28.0–110.0］對108.0［90.8–127.5］分鐘，p＝0.54。Maestro 組無病例需要轉為開腹手術，基準對照組則有25例中的3例（12%）。兩組併發症發生率及住院天數相近。未發生裝置相關不良事件。
結論：在這項依手術類型分層的初步分析中，Maestro 輔助 EGS 與較短的手術時間相關；在結腸切除等複雜手術中，亦呈現住院天數較短及轉開腹率較低的趨勢，同時維持相近的安全性結果。此平台似乎可適用於多種急診適應症，並可能有助於在急診情境採行微創手術。仍需要更大型的前瞻性研究，以確認這些觀察結果，並界定協作式機器人平台在急診外科照護中的角色。

papers.title: The oral-gut immune axis: a bidirectional hypothesis of the oral cavity as an immune programming hub for systemic and gut mucosal immunity
papers.authors: Wang Q, A L, Huan Y, Fang R, Cao C, Suo M
papers.abstract: The oral cavity has long been viewed simply as the site of food intake. Research in recent years has shown that the oral mucosa is a site of chronic low-grade inflammation that continuously produces inflammatory mediators. Given its specific structure, microbial products and immune mediators in the oral cavity can enter the bloodstream, while swallowed saliva continuously delivers oral microorganisms and their products to the gut. Oral dysbiosis, particularly in periodontitis, has been associated with systemic immune reprogramming, including trained immunity of monocytes, neutrophil priming, and expansion of gut-homing T helper 17 (Th17) cells. These modifications may contribute to intestinal barrier dysfunction, alterations in gut microbiota composition, and an increased risk of inflammatory bowel disease, colorectal cancer, and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. However, current evidence is largely associative: the presence of oral bacteria in intestinal tissue does not establish that they initiate intestinal disease, and an inflamed gut may itself favor the colonization of oral-derived taxa. Bidirectional influences between oral and gut inflammation therefore cannot be excluded, and reverse causation remains plausible. Genetic studies have identified polymorphisms in genes of innate immunity, such as nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-containing protein 2 (NOD2), interleukin-23 receptor (IL23R), and the interleukin-1 gene cluster (IL1 cluster), in both periodontitis and gastrointestinal diseases. However, because these loci are highly pleiotropic and have been associated with multiple inflammatory disorders affecting different organs, shared susceptibility genes alone cannot distinguish a genuine oral-to-gut axis from independent diseases sharing common immune-related genetic architecture. We propose the Oral-Gut Immune Axis (OGIA) here as a testable hypothesis, not as an established paradigm. OGIA is a predominantly, but not exclusively, oral-to-gut directional model that positions the oral cavity as a potential immune programming hub. Under specific genetic and microbial conditions, periodontal inflammation may act as an upstream contributor to gastrointestinal pathology. This framework generates testable predictions and identifies oral-targeted interventions as candidate preventive strategies, while acknowledging that current evidence remains insufficient to establish causality. Accordingly, the OGIA framework does not claim that microbial translocation is a demonstrated cause of human gastrointestinal disease. It treats translocation as one candidate mechanism among several, to be discriminated from systemic immune signaling in future studies.

papers.abstract_zh: 長久以來，口腔一直被單純視為攝取食物的場所。近年研究顯示，口腔黏膜是慢性低度發炎的部位，會持續產生發炎介質。由於口腔的特殊結構，其中的微生物產物與免疫介質可進入血液循環，而吞入的唾液則持續將口腔微生物及其產物帶入腸道。口腔菌相失衡，尤其是牙周炎中的菌相失衡，與全身性免疫重新程式化有關，包括單核球的訓練性免疫、嗜中性球的預活化，以及具有腸道歸巢能力的輔助型T細胞17（Th17）擴增。這些變化可能促成腸道屏障功能障礙、腸道菌相組成改變，以及發炎性腸道疾病、大腸直腸癌與代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝病風險增加。然而，目前證據大多屬於關聯性：在腸道組織中發現口腔細菌，並不能證明這些細菌啟動了腸道疾病，而發炎的腸道本身也可能有利於口腔來源菌群定殖。因此，不能排除口腔與腸道發炎之間存在雙向影響，反向因果關係仍有可能。遺傳研究已在牙周炎與胃腸道疾病中，辨識出先天免疫相關基因的多型性，例如含核苷酸結合寡聚化結構域蛋白2（NOD2）、介白素23受體（IL23R），以及介白素1基因群（IL1 cluster）。然而，由於這些基因座具有高度多效性，且與影響不同器官的多種發炎性疾病有關，僅憑共同的易感性基因，無法區分真正的口腔至腸道作用軸，與共享免疫相關遺傳架構的獨立疾病。我們在此提出口腔—腸道免疫軸（OGIA），將其定位為可檢驗的假說，而非已確立的典範。OGIA是一個主要、但非完全由口腔指向腸道的方向性模型，將口腔定位為潛在的免疫程式化樞紐。在特定遺傳與微生物條件下，牙周發炎可能是促成胃腸道病理變化的上游因素。此架構可產生可檢驗的預測，並將針對口腔的介入措施列為候選預防策略，同時承認目前證據仍不足以確立因果關係。因此，OGIA架構並未宣稱微生物移位已被證實是人類胃腸道疾病的成因。此架構將微生物移位視為數個候選機制之一，未來研究需將其與全身性免疫訊號傳遞的作用加以區辨。

papers.title: Application and future prospects of bispecific antibodies in the treatment of colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Long K, Zeng Y, Chen C, Yao Q
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, the incidence of colorectal cancer (CRC) has continued to rise, imposing a substantial disease burden on both patients and society. Improvements in treatment strategies-including surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy-have significantly improved clinical outcomes. Immunotherapy, particularly immune checkpoint inhibitors, has shown promising efficacy in rectal cancer studies. Nevertheless, multiple CRC subtypes are still hindered by an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, the development of therapeutic resistance, and low response rates to immunotherapy, collectively limiting further gains in clinical benefit. As an emerging therapeutic modality, bispecific antibodies (BsAbs) possess two binding specificities, enabling them to bind simultaneously to the same or different antigens, thereby generating multifaceted anti-tumor effects. Therefore, BsAbs can help overcome treatment resistance and potentiate antitumor immune responses. To date, numerous BsAbs have been used in clinical trials to assess their safety and efficacy across diverse CRC subtypes. This review summarizes the main classes of BsAbs used for CRC treatment, focusing on their mechanisms of action and recent advances in clinical research. We further discuss existing challenges for BsAbs and the potential strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 過去十年間，大腸直腸癌（CRC）的發生率持續上升，對病人與社會造成沉重的疾病負擔。治療策略的進步，包括手術、化學治療、標靶治療與免疫治療，已顯著改善臨床結果。免疫治療，尤其是免疫檢查點抑制劑，在直腸癌研究中展現出令人期待的療效。然而，多種 CRC 亞型仍受到免疫抑制性腫瘤微環境、治療抗藥性的產生，以及免疫治療反應率偏低所限制，這些因素共同阻礙了臨床效益的進一步提升。作為一種新興治療方式，雙特異性抗體（BsAbs）具有兩種結合特異性，能同時結合相同或不同的抗原，從而產生多面向的抗腫瘤作用。因此，BsAbs 有助於克服治療抗藥性，並增強抗腫瘤免疫反應。迄今，已有許多 BsAbs 用於臨床試驗，以評估其在不同 CRC 亞型中的安全性與療效。本篇綜述彙整用於 CRC 治療的 BsAbs 主要類別，著重於其作用機轉及臨床研究的最新進展。我們進一步討論 BsAbs 現存的挑戰與潛在策略。

papers.title: Eosinophils in cancer immunity: context-dependent plasticity, biomarker potential, and therapeutic opportunities
papers.authors: Li N, Chen W, Zeng Y, Wang N, Wang J
papers.abstract: Eosinophils, traditionally associated with type 2 immunity, are increasingly recognized as context-dependent regulators of cancer immunity. Their effects are not intrinsically anti-tumorigenic or pro-tumorigenic but are shaped by five partially distinct dimensions of context: tumor type and stage, anatomical compartment and microlocalization, cytokine milieu and activation state, the circulating-versus-tissue compartment, and treatment exposure. This Review critically synthesizes mechanistic and clinical evidence defining this functional plasticity, with explicit separation of murine and human evidence throughout. Eosinophils can directly kill tumor cells through granule proteins and reactive oxygen species, recruit and activate cytotoxic lymphocytes, promote vascular normalization, and participate in interleukin-33-dependent anti-tumor circuits. In other settings, they can facilitate metastatic dissemination, angiogenesis, tissue remodeling, and immune suppression. These opposing functions help explain the heterogeneous clinical associations reported across malignancies. Tissue eosinophils at the invasive tumor front are associated with longer time to recurrence in colorectal cancer, whereas peripheral eosinophil dynamics have emerged as candidate biomarkers during immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in non-small cell lung cancer; eosinophilic malignant pleural effusion may also define a distinct prognostic subgroup. We critically distinguish prognostic, predictive, and pharmacodynamic biomarker claims, and emphasize that most reported associations remain prognostic rather than demonstrated predictors of treatment benefit. We further discuss therapeutic opportunities involving the interleukin-5/interleukin-33/eotaxin axis, induced eosinophils, and eosinophil-assisted cellular therapy, graded by their level of clinical maturity and weighed against the risks of systemic eosinophil activation. We argue that clinically useful eosinophil biomarkers will require integration of abundance with phenotype, spatial localization, tissue compartment, and treatment context. This framework clarifies when eosinophils are protective, harmful, or therapeutically exploitable and highlights priorities for prospective human studies in cancer immunology and precision immunotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 癌症免疫中的嗜酸性球：情境依賴的可塑性、生物標記潛力與治療契機
papers.abstract_zh: 嗜酸性球傳統上被認為與第二型免疫相關，如今愈來愈被視為癌症免疫中具有情境依賴性的調節者。其作用本質上並非抗腫瘤或促腫瘤，而是受到五個部分相異的情境面向所塑造：腫瘤類型與分期、解剖區室與微觀定位、細胞激素環境與活化狀態、循環與組織區室的差異，以及治療暴露。本綜述批判性地整合界定此功能可塑性的機轉與臨床證據，並在全文中明確區分小鼠與人類證據。嗜酸性球可透過顆粒蛋白與活性氧物種直接殺死腫瘤細胞、招募並活化細胞毒性淋巴球、促進血管正常化，以及參與介白素-33依賴的抗腫瘤迴路。在其他情境下，嗜酸性球則可能促進轉移播散、血管新生、組織重塑與免疫抑制。這些相反的功能有助於解釋不同惡性腫瘤中所報告之臨床關聯的異質性。在大腸直腸癌中，位於腫瘤侵犯前緣的組織嗜酸性球與較長的復發時間相關；而在非小細胞肺癌接受免疫檢查點抑制劑治療期間，周邊血嗜酸性球的動態變化已成為候選生物標記；嗜酸性球性惡性肋膜積液也可能界定出預後不同的亞群。我們批判性地區分預後性、預測性與藥效動態生物標記的主張，並強調多數已報告的關聯仍屬預後性，而非已證實可預測治療效益的指標。我們進一步討論涉及介白素-5／介白素-33／嗜酸性球趨化因子軸、誘導型嗜酸性球，以及嗜酸性球輔助細胞治療的治療契機，依其臨床成熟度分級，並權衡全身性嗜酸性球活化的風險。我們主張，具有臨床實用性的嗜酸性球生物標記，需要整合其數量、表型、空間定位、組織區室與治療情境。此架構釐清嗜酸性球何時具有保護性、有害性或可供治療利用，並凸顯癌症免疫學與精準免疫治療領域中，前瞻性人體研究的優先方向。

papers.title: Anatomical stratification and robot-assisted radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer after colorectal cancer surgery
papers.authors: Liu S, He Y, Gu Z
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) and prostate cancer (PCa) are the most common malignancies of the digestive and genitourinary tracts in men, respectively, and their coexistence is increasing as populations age and survival improves. Second primary PCa is the most frequent second primary malignancy among male CRC survivors, yet current guidelines provide no dedicated recommendations for diagnosis or treatment in this setting. Pelvic anatomy after CRC surgery is not uniform: the prior colorectal procedure determines the relationship between the colorectal anastomosis and the posterior aspect of the prostate, and therefore whether the Denonvilliers fascia-anterior rectal space is preserved, scarred or absent. This variable is the principal determinant of surgical difficulty and approach choice and can be assessed preoperatively. Drawing on a SEER analysis and published evidence, this review summarises the epidemiological association and shared mechanisms of the two tumours (host and metabolic factors, molecular pathways, genetic susceptibility and treatment-related second primaries), describes procedure-specific anatomical and functional changes, and proposes an approach-selection matrix defined by two independent axes: abdominal access difficulty and posterior-plane risk. Transperitoneal, extraperitoneal, single-port transvesical and transperineal routes are compared, followed by a seven-step surgical framework for robot-assisted radical prostatectomy, together with oncological and functional outcomes, complications and centre-level quality control. The reverse challenge of CRC developing after PCa treatment, and the limitations of a predominantly retrospective evidence base, are also discussed. The resulting anatomy-based framework links the pre-treatment colorectal history to a reproducible diagnostic and surgical strategy for PCa in CRC survivors.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌手術後攝護腺癌的解剖分層與機器人輔助根除性攝護腺切除術
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）與攝護腺癌（PCa）分別是男性消化道及泌尿生殖道最常見的惡性腫瘤，隨著人口老化及存活改善，兩者並存的情形日益增加。第二原發性PCa是男性CRC存活者最常見的第二原發惡性腫瘤，但現行指引尚未針對此情境提供專門的診斷或治療建議。CRC手術後的骨盆解剖並非一致：先前的大腸直腸手術方式決定大腸直腸吻合處與攝護腺後方的相對關係，進而決定Denonvilliers筋膜—直腸前方間隙是保留、瘢痕化，或已不存在。此變項是手術難度與入路選擇的主要決定因素，且可於術前評估。本綜述依據一項SEER分析及已發表證據，彙整兩種腫瘤的流行病學關聯與共同機轉（宿主及代謝因素、分子路徑、遺傳易感性，以及治療相關的第二原發癌），描述各種手術特有的解剖及功能變化，並提出由兩個獨立軸線界定的入路選擇矩陣：腹部進入難度與後方剝離平面風險。本文比較經腹膜、腹膜外、單孔經膀胱及經會陰入路，接著提出機器人輔助根除性攝護腺切除術的七步驟手術架構，並討論腫瘤學與功能性結果、併發症及中心層級的品質管控。本文亦討論PCa治療後發生CRC的反向挑戰，以及證據基礎主要來自回溯性研究的限制。最終形成的解剖導向架構，將治療前的大腸直腸手術病史，連結至CRC存活者發生PCa時可重現的診斷與手術策略。

papers.title: Jiedu Sangen Decoction for Colorectal Cancer: Pharmacological Mechanisms, Network Pharmacology Perspective and the Interaction With Gut Microbiota
papers.authors: Zhu Z, Guo S, Gao W, Liu Q, Shen M, Ruan S
papers.abstract: Jiedu Sangen Decoction (JSD) is a traditional Chinese medicine formula used in the management of colorectal cancer (CRC). This review critically summarizes current evidence on the pharmacological effects of JSD, integrating experimental studies of the complete formula, network pharmacology predictions, mechanistic evidence from its constituent herbs and compounds, and potential interactions with the gut microbiota. Experimental studies of the complete JSD formula indicate that it can inhibit CRC cell proliferation and promote apoptosis, suppress invasion and metastasis through regulation of epithelial-mesenchymal transition(EMT) and cancer-associated fibroblasts(CAFs), and enhance sensitivity to 5-fluorouracil by modulating glycolytic metabolism. Network pharmacology further suggests a multi-component and multi-target mode of action involving candidate hub targets and signaling pathways that partially converge with experimentally observed mechanisms. Individual JSD-associated compounds also exhibit diverse anticancer and microbiota-modulating activities; however, these findings should be regarded as supportive mechanistic evidence rather than direct evidence for the complete formula. In particular, direct evidence that JSD modulates the gut microbiota or microbial metabolites in CRC remains limited. Moreover, despite accumulating preclinical findings, high-quality clinical evidence evaluating the efficacy and safety of JSD in CRC is currently insufficient. Further studies integrating standardized chemical characterization, mechanistic validation, microbiome research, and well-designed clinical investigations are needed to establish the translational relevance of JSD in CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 解毒三根湯（JSD）是用於大腸直腸癌（CRC）治療的傳統中藥複方。本綜述以批判性方式總結目前有關JSD藥理作用的證據，整合完整複方的實驗研究、網絡藥理學預測、其組成藥材與化合物的機轉證據，以及與腸道菌群的潛在交互作用。完整JSD複方的實驗研究顯示，其可抑制CRC細胞增殖並促進細胞凋亡，透過調控上皮－間質轉化（EMT）及癌症相關纖維母細胞（CAFs）抑制侵襲與轉移，並藉由調節糖解代謝，提高對5-fluorouracil的敏感性。網絡藥理學進一步提示，其作用模式涉及多成分與多靶點，包括候選樞紐靶點及訊息傳遞路徑，且與實驗觀察到的機轉部分匯合。與JSD相關的個別化合物亦呈現多樣的抗癌及菌群調節活性；然而，這些發現應視為支持性的機轉證據，而非完整複方的直接證據。尤其，目前JSD在CRC中調節腸道菌群或微生物代謝物的直接證據仍有限。此外，儘管臨床前研究發現持續累積，目前評估JSD用於CRC之療效與安全性的高品質臨床證據仍不足。未來需要整合標準化化學特性分析、機轉驗證、微生物組研究及設計良好的臨床研究，才能確立JSD在CRC中的轉譯應用價值。

papers.title: Biological characteristics of secreted modular calcium-binding protein 2 and its mechanisms in disease progression: Current advances in targeted therapies
papers.authors: Lan T, Wang R, Liu F, Wang Q, Yan Q, Liu X
papers.abstract: Secreted modular calcium-binding protein 2 (SMOC2) is a secreted matricellular protein belonging to the SPARC family. It is widely distributed throughout the body and plays complex roles in embryonic development, tissue homeostasis, and pathological conditions such as fibrosis, cancer, and inflammation. By regulating multiple key signaling pathways, SMOC2 can exert pathogenic and protective effects on cellular behavior. Studies involving human samples, animal models, and cell experiments have shown that SMOC2 is implicated in fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transformation and may contribute to fibrosis in the heart, kidneys, lungs, and liver. However, in cancer, SMOC2 exhibits context-dependent duality: it exerts tumor-suppressive effects in gastric and hepatocellular carcinomas, whereas it has been reported to promote tumor progression in renal, gallbladder, pancreatic, and endometrial cancers. Additionally, its functional role in colorectal cancer appears spatially dichotomous-largely tumor-suppressive in the tumor bulk but pro-invasive at the invasive front in some models-and requires further elucidation. This narrative review examines the pathological roles of SMOC2, with particular attention to its potential as a biomarker and therapeutic target, and discusses the challenges associated with its clinical translation.

papers.abstract_zh: 分泌型模組化鈣結合蛋白2（SMOC2）是一種屬於SPARC家族的分泌型細胞外基質調節蛋白。它廣泛分布於全身，在胚胎發育、組織恆定，以及纖維化、癌症與發炎等病理狀態中扮演複雜角色。透過調節多條關鍵訊息傳遞路徑，SMOC2可對細胞行為產生致病與保護作用。涉及人體檢體、動物模型及細胞實驗的研究顯示，SMOC2參與纖維母細胞向肌纖維母細胞的轉化，並可能促進心臟、腎臟、肺臟及肝臟的纖維化。然而，在癌症中，SMOC2呈現依情境而異的雙重作用：它在胃癌與肝細胞癌中具有抑癌作用，但有研究報告指出，它會促進腎癌、膽囊癌、胰臟癌及子宮內膜癌的腫瘤進展。此外，它在大腸直腸癌中的功能似乎呈現空間上的二分性——在部分模型中，於腫瘤主體主要具有抑癌作用，但在侵襲前緣則促進侵犯——仍需進一步釐清。本篇敘述性綜述探討SMOC2的病理作用，特別著重其作為生物標記及治療標靶的潛力，並討論其臨床轉譯面臨的挑戰。

papers.title: Perioperative Continuation Versus Discontinuation of Antiplatelet Therapy in Colorectal Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Bleeding and Thrombotic Events
papers.authors: Morarasu S, Morarasu B, Guzga E, Sorodoc L, Dimofte G, Lunca S
papers.abstract: Background: Perioperative management of antiplatelet therapy in colorectal surgery requires balancing the risk of surgical bleeding against cardiovascular and cerebrovascular complications after treatment withdrawal. This meta-analysis assessed the safety of continuing antiplatelet therapy compared with preoperative discontinuation. Methods: PubMed and Embase were searched through 30 May 2026 for comparative studies of adults undergoing colorectal surgery. Random-effects models were used to pool odds ratios (ORs) for dichotomous outcomes and mean differences (MDs) for continuous outcomes. The clinically relevant analysis was restricted to patients already receiving antiplatelet therapy with separately reported continuation and discontinuation groups. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I and certainty of evidence with GRADE. Results: Seven observational studies were included in the systematic review, of which four (505 patients; 209 continuation and 296 discontinuation) contributed to the primary analysis. Continuation was not associated with statistically significant differences in postoperative bleeding (OR 2.65, 95% CI 0.78-8.99), thrombotic events (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.06-1.32), transfusion (OR 1.39, 95% CI 0.35-5.51), overall morbidity (OR 2.08, 95% CI 0.97-4.48), intraoperative blood loss (MD -2.74 mL, 95% CI -13.07 to 7.59), or operative time (MD 0.72 min, 95% CI -11.83 to 13.27). Hospital stay was longer with continuation (MD 0.65 days, 95% CI 0.40-0.91). In the broader secondary analysis, continuation was associated with increased postoperative bleeding (OR 3.30, 95% CI 1.40-7.78). GRADE certainty was very low for all outcomes. Conclusions: Among established antiplatelet users undergoing colorectal surgery, continuation was not associated with statistically significant differences in bleeding or thrombotic outcomes compared with discontinuation. However, sparse events, imprecise estimates, and very low certainty of evidence preclude definitive safety conclusions. Perioperative management should be individualized according to thrombotic risk, anticipated bleeding risk, and surgical complexity.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：大腸直腸手術圍手術期的抗血小板治療管理，必須在手術出血風險與停藥後心血管及腦血管併發症之間取得平衡。本統合分析評估持續抗血小板治療相較於術前停藥的安全性。方法：搜尋 PubMed 與 Embase，納入截至2026年5月30日接受大腸直腸手術之成人的比較性研究。使用隨機效應模型，對二元結果合併勝算比（OR），對連續結果合併平均差（MD）。具臨床相關性的分析僅納入原已接受抗血小板治療，且分別報告持續用藥組與停藥組結果的病人。使用 ROBINS-I 評估偏差風險，並以 GRADE 評估證據確定性。結果：系統性回顧納入7篇觀察性研究，其中4篇納入主要分析，共505人，持續用藥組209人、停藥組296人。持續用藥與術後出血（OR 2.65，95% CI 0.78–8.99）、血栓事件（OR 0.29，95% CI 0.06–1.32）、輸血（OR 1.39，95% CI 0.35–5.51）、整體併發症（OR 2.08，95% CI 0.97–4.48）、術中失血量（MD −2.74 mL，95% CI −13.07至7.59）或手術時間（MD 0.72分鐘，95% CI −11.83至13.27）均無統計上顯著差異。持續用藥組的住院時間較長（MD 0.65天，95% CI 0.40–0.91）。在涵蓋範圍較廣的次要分析中，持續用藥與術後出血增加相關（OR 3.30，95% CI 1.40–7.78）。所有結果的 GRADE 證據確定性均為極低。結論：在原已使用抗血小板藥物、接受大腸直腸手術的病人中，相較於停藥，持續用藥與出血或血栓結果均無統計上顯著差異。然而，事件稀少、估計不精確及證據確定性極低，使本研究無法對安全性作出確定結論。圍手術期管理應依血栓風險、預期出血風險及手術複雜度個別化。

papers.title: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy plus chemoradiotherapy versus chemoradiotherapy alone for locally advanced rectal cancer: meta-analysis
papers.authors: Lei X, Zhang Y, Wang L, Xie X, Yan M, Li Y
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Standard neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) for locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) achieves variable pathological responses. Incorporating immune checkpoint inhibitors into nCRT (inCRT) is a promising intensification strategy, but its efficacy and impact on surgical safety remain poorly defined. This meta-analysis evaluated the oncological benefits and surgical risks of inCRT versus nCRT in both proficient and deficient mismatch repair LARC.
METHODS: A systematic search of the PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and the Cochrane Library databases was conducted for randomized clinical trials (RCTs) published from inception up to February 2026. The primary outcomes were pathological complete response (pCR) and grade ≥ III severe adverse events (SAEs) according to the Clavien-Dindo complication grading system. Secondary outcomes included major pathological response (MPR) and postoperative complications. Pooled risk ratios (RRs) were calculated using random-effects or fixed-effects models.
RESULTS: Seven RCTs including 1117 patients were identified. Five trials did not restrict enrolment based on mismatch repair or microsatellite instability status, whereas two trials exclusively enrolled patients with mismatch repair-proficient/microsatellite-stable tumours. Although inCRT significantly increased the rate of pCR (31.9% versus 19.3%; RR 1.70; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.37 to 2.10; P < 0.001) and MPR (55.1% versus 40.3%; RR 1.38; 95% c.i. 1.20 to 1.59; P < 0.001) versus nCRT, it was associated with a significantly higher risk of SAEs (30.1% versus 26.8%; RR 1.24; 95% c.i. 1.03 to 1.49; P = 0.02) and overall postoperative complications (32.8% versus 25.6%; RR 1.27; 95% c.i. 1.02 to 1.58; P = 0.03). Subgroup analysis indicated that the pCR benefit was most pronounced in cohorts receiving short-course radiotherapy and consolidation immunotherapy.
CONCLUSION: The addition of immunotherapy to neoadjuvant therapy for LARC markedly improves pathological response but increases high-grade toxicity and surgical morbidity. Although inCRT is a potent intensification strategy, stringent patient selection and regimen optimization are required before widespread adoption.

papers.title_zh: 新輔助免疫治療合併放化療與單純放化療治療局部進展期直腸癌：統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）接受標準新輔助放化療（nCRT）後，病理反應程度不一。在nCRT中加入免疫檢查點抑制劑（inCRT）是一項具潛力的強化治療策略，但其療效及對手術安全性的影響仍未明確。本統合分析評估inCRT相較於nCRT，對錯配修復功能正常及缺陷型LARC的腫瘤學效益與手術風險。
方法：系統性搜尋PubMed、Web of Science、Embase及Cochrane Library資料庫，納入自資料庫建立至2026年2月發表的隨機臨床試驗（RCT）。主要結果為病理完全緩解（pCR），以及依Clavien-Dindo併發症分級系統判定之第III級以上嚴重不良事件（SAEs）。次要結果包括主要病理反應（MPR）與術後併發症。使用隨機效應或固定效應模型計算合併風險比（RR）。
結果：共納入7項RCT、1117名患者。5項試驗未依錯配修復或微衛星不穩定狀態限制收案，另2項試驗僅納入錯配修復功能正常／微衛星穩定型腫瘤患者。相較於nCRT，inCRT顯著提高pCR率（31.9%對19.3%；RR 1.70；95%信賴區間1.37至2.10；P < 0.001）與MPR率（55.1%對40.3%；RR 1.38；95%信賴區間1.20至1.59；P < 0.001），但也與顯著較高的SAEs風險（30.1%對26.8%；RR 1.24；95%信賴區間1.03至1.49；P = 0.02）及整體術後併發症風險（32.8%對25.6%；RR 1.27；95%信賴區間1.02至1.58；P = 0.03）相關。次群組分析顯示，接受短程放射治療及鞏固免疫治療的族群，其pCR效益最為明顯。
結論：在LARC新輔助治療中加入免疫治療，可明顯改善病理反應，但會增加高等級毒性及手術相關併發症。雖然inCRT是一項強效的治療強化策略，在廣泛採用前仍須嚴格篩選患者並優化療程。

papers.title: Comparative influence of opioid-free versus opioid-containing anesthetic techniques upon Th1/Th2 balance during laparoscopic colorectal cancer procedures: a randomized controlled trial
papers.authors: Hong L, Wang Y, Cheng Z, Luan H, Zhao Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Surgical resection is central to colorectal cancer management, but surgery and anesthesia can induce perioperative immunosuppression. Opioids, a mainstay of perioperative analgesia, may impair cellular immunity, including disruption of Th1/Th2 immune equilibrium. This randomized controlled trial evaluated whether opioid-free anesthesia (OFA) better preserves perioperative immune function than opioid-based anesthesia.
METHODS: Sixty patients scheduled for elective laparoscopic colorectal cancer resection were randomly allocated to OFA (dexmedetomidine, esketamine, lidocaine) or opioid-based anesthesia (sufentanil, remifentanil). Peripheral blood was sampled before induction and on postoperative days 1 and 5 to measure Th1/Th2 ratio, CD4⁺/CD8⁺ ratio and natural killer (NK)-cell counts. Serum cortisol, measures of postoperative pain and complications, including postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), were documented.
RESULTS: On postoperative day 5, the Th1/Th2 ratio was markedly reduced in patients given OFA relative to the control (C) group (1.14 ± 0.40 vs. 1.57 ± 0.89, P = 0.017); in the C group it had returned to baseline, whereas it remained suppressed with OFA. CD4⁺/CD8⁺ ratios and NK-cell counts showed no between-group differences at any point. Cortisol levels at the end of surgery and Numeric Rating Scale pain scores on day 1 were significantly lower with opioid-based anesthesia, while PONV incidence was lower with OFA.
CONCLUSIONS: In laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery, the OFA regimen used in this trial was associated with sustained postoperative reduction of the Th1/Th2 ratio compared with opioid-based anesthesia. Although OFA reduced PONV, its potential to prolong Th1/Th2 suppression warrants caution when selecting anesthetic strategies for these patients.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: This trial was retrospectively registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry under ChiCTR2500101735 (registered April 29, 2025).

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：手術切除是大腸直腸癌治療的核心，但手術與麻醉可能誘發圍手術期免疫抑制。鴉片類藥物是圍手術期止痛的主要用藥，可能損害細胞免疫，包括擾亂Th1/Th2免疫平衡。本隨機對照試驗評估無鴉片類麻醉（OFA）是否比以鴉片類藥物為基礎的麻醉更能保留圍手術期免疫功能。
方法：將60名預定接受擇期腹腔鏡大腸直腸癌切除術的病人，隨機分配接受OFA（dexmedetomidine、艾司氯胺酮、lidocaine）或以鴉片類藥物為基礎的麻醉（sufentanil、remifentanil）。於麻醉誘導前及術後第1、5天採集周邊血液，測量Th1/Th2比值、CD4⁺/CD8⁺比值及自然殺手（NK）細胞數。另記錄血清皮質醇、術後疼痛評估結果及併發症，包括術後噁心嘔吐（PONV）。
結果：術後第5天，OFA組的Th1/Th2比值明顯低於對照（C）組（1.14 ± 0.40 vs. 1.57 ± 0.89，P = 0.017）；C組已恢復至基線值，OFA組則仍處於受抑制狀態。CD4⁺/CD8⁺比值及NK細胞數在所有時間點均無組間差異。以鴉片類藥物為基礎的麻醉組，其手術結束時皮質醇濃度及術後第1天數字評分量表疼痛分數顯著較低；OFA組的PONV發生率則較低。
結論：在腹腔鏡大腸直腸癌手術中，相較於以鴉片類藥物為基礎的麻醉，本試驗使用的OFA配方與術後Th1/Th2比值持續降低有關。雖然OFA減少PONV，但其可能延長Th1/Th2受抑制狀態，因此為這類病人選擇麻醉策略時應審慎考量。
試驗註冊：本試驗於中國臨床試驗註冊中心回溯性註冊，編號ChiCTR2500101735（註冊日期：2025年4月29日）。

papers.title: Distribution and Cytotoxic Potential of NK Cell Subsets in Conventional and Immune-Protective Anesthetic Strategies: A Randomized Study in Colorectal Cancer Patients
papers.authors: de Knijff P, Vulcano T, Jongman R, Olthof C, Struys M, Abdulahad W
papers.abstract: Emerging evidence suggests that anesthesia can modulate natural killer (NK) cell activity, potentially influencing anti-tumor immunity. In this randomized study, 14 patients undergoing laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery received an immune-protective anesthetic strategy (propofol/epidural/dexmedetomidine) or a conventional strategy (sevoflurane/opioids). Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were collected preoperatively and at 24 and 48 h postoperatively. CD56+CD16+ NK-cell subsets were characterized by flow cytometry based on NKG2A, NKG2C, and KIR expression. Cytotoxic potential was assessed by intracellular perforin and granzyme B, and CD107a expression as a degranulation marker. Significant decreases from 0 to 48 h were observed in the conventional group for NKG2A+KIR+ double-positive (DP) NK cells (-0.69 percentage points, p = 0.02) and terminally differentiated (NKG2A-NKG2C-) NK cells (-2.22 percentage points, p = 0.02). CD107a expression in DP NK cells increased at 48 h versus baseline (+44.9% MFI, p = 0.04) only in the conventional group. Intracellular granzyme B (-3.38 percentage points; p = 0.02) and perforin levels (-4.56 percentage points, p = 0.04) decreased from 0 to 48 h in the conventional group. These findings suggest that an immune-protective anesthetic strategy may better preserve NK cell subset distribution and cytotoxic potential. However, given the modest magnitude of changes, these results should be interpreted as exploratory.

papers.title: Seed Oils, Dietary Linoleic Acid, and Omega-6 Biomarkers in Adult Health: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses
papers.authors: Clemente-Suárez V, Yáñez-Sepúlveda R, López-Gil J, Martín-Rodríguez A, Villanueva-Tobaldo C, Tornero-Aguilera J
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Seed oils are widely consumed, yet claims linking linoleic acid (LA) and omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-6 PUFAs) to inflammation and chronic disease remain contentious. We evaluated the evidence in adults while separating named oils, dietary fatty acids, and circulating/tissue biomarkers. Methods: PubMed/MEDLINE and Europe PMC were searched to 1 October 2026, with supplementary and citation searches. Adult systematic reviews/meta-analyses were eligible; pregnancy and pediatric populations were excluded. Every synthesis was appraised item by item with AMSTAR 2 (A MeaSurement Tool to Assess systematic Reviews 2) and ROBIS (Risk Of Bias In Systematic reviews) and assigned a confidence tier by a rule defined post hoc, during peer review. Overlap was quantified with the corrected covered area; sensitivity and subgroup analyses examined the Sydney Diet Heart Study, the Minnesota Coronary Experiment, and LA-specific trials. No meta-meta-analysis was performed. The review was not prospectively registered. Results: Thirty-three syntheses were included; the six of higher confidence were not independent (four from one World Health Organization-commissioned program sharing trials). Clinical-endpoint evidence concerned LA/n-6 exposures, largely biomarker-based; named-oil evidence came from short-term trials of intermediate outcomes. Randomized evidence increasing omega-6 showed little or no effect on all-cause mortality (risk ratio [RR] 1.00, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.88-1.12; robust to both trials) or cardiovascular events (RR 0.97, 0.81-1.15; heterogeneity mainly from the Sydney trial), with low certainty; in a hypothesis-generating subgroup, LA-specific trials showed more cardiovascular events than mixed n-6/omega-3 (n-3) trials (RR 1.45 vs. 0.80; two trials each). Prospective dietary/circulating evidence generally showed inverse associations, mostly from overlapping cohorts. LA-rich oils lowered low-density lipoprotein cholesterol when replacing butter (sunflower -0.34 mmol/L per 10% of energy) but differed little from other unsaturated oils, without increasing major inflammatory markers. Cancer findings varied by site and exposure metric, including an ungraded positive dietary LA-colorectal cancer association with an imprecise tissue LA estimate. Conclusions: In adults, the evidence does not support a uniform harmful or beneficial effect of seed oils as a class. Interpretation depends on the oil, replacement nutrient, background n-3 intake, exposure metric, outcome, and design; most evidence is of low certainty, and long-term clinical-outcome evidence for individual oils remains limited.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景／目的：種子油被廣泛食用，但將亞麻油酸（LA）與 omega-6 多元不飽和脂肪酸（n-6 PUFAs）連結至發炎及慢性疾病的說法仍具爭議。我們評估成人的相關證據，並將特定油品、膳食脂肪酸及循環／組織生物標記分開處理。方法：檢索 PubMed/MEDLINE 與 Europe PMC 至 2026 年 10 月 1 日，並進行補充檢索及引文檢索。納入成人的系統性回顧／統合分析；排除孕婦及兒童族群。每篇證據綜整均以 AMSTAR 2（系統性回顧評讀工具第二版）及 ROBIS（系統性回顧偏差風險工具）逐項評讀，並依同儕審查期間事後訂定的規則分配可信度層級。以校正涵蓋面積量化研究重疊程度；敏感度及次群組分析檢視了雪梨飲食心臟研究、明尼蘇達冠狀動脈實驗，以及專門針對 LA 的試驗。未進行統合分析的再統合分析。本回顧未事先註冊。結果：共納入 33 篇證據綜整；其中可信度較高的 6 篇並非彼此獨立，其中 4 篇來自同一個由世界衛生組織委託、共用試驗的研究計畫。臨床終點證據涉及 LA／n-6 暴露，主要以生物標記為基礎；特定油品的證據則來自評估中間結果的短期試驗。增加 omega-6 攝取的隨機試驗證據顯示，對全因死亡率幾乎沒有或沒有影響（風險比［RR］1.00，95% 信賴區間［CI］0.88–1.12；針對上述兩項試驗的敏感度分析結果均穩健），對心血管事件亦然（RR 0.97，0.81–1.15；異質性主要來自雪梨試驗），證據確定性低；在用於產生假說的次群組分析中，專門針對 LA 的試驗較混合 n-6／omega-3（n-3）的試驗呈現更多心血管事件（RR 分別為 1.45 與 0.80；各有兩項試驗）。前瞻性的膳食／循環生物標記證據整體呈現反向關聯，但多來自彼此重疊的世代研究。以富含 LA 的油品取代奶油可降低低密度脂蛋白膽固醇（葵花油每取代總熱量的 10%，降低 0.34 mmol/L），但與其他不飽和油品相比差異不大，且未增加主要發炎標記。癌症結果依癌別及暴露測量指標而異，包括一項未評定證據等級的膳食 LA 與大腸直腸癌正向關聯，以及一項不精確的組織 LA 估計值。結論：在成人中，現有證據不支持將種子油視為整個類別時具有一致的有害或有益效果。解讀取決於油品、被取代的營養素、背景 n-3 攝取量、暴露測量指標、結果及研究設計；多數證據的確定性低，而個別油品的長期臨床結果證據仍有限。

papers.title: Preoperative prediction of histological types and Ki-67 expression in rectal tumors using time-dependent diffusion MRI quantitative parameters
papers.authors: Li Y, Yi S, Shao C, Ma X, Li H, Chen M
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the clinical value of Time-dependent diffusion MRI (td-dMRI) quantitative parameters in differentiating between rectal neuroendocrine neoplasms (rNEN) and rectal adenocarcinoma (RAC) and in distinguishing between high and low Ki-67 expression in RAC.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This two-center study prospectively enrolled 90 patients with rectal tumors who underwent td-dMRI (January 2024 to March 2025), including 85 with RAC (development cohort, n = 61, validation cohort, n = 24) and 5 with rNEN. The td-dMRI-derived microstructural parameters were estimated using the IMPULSED model, and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values were measured at different diffusion times. Firth's logistic regression was performed for rNEN-associated parameter selection, while standard logistic regression identified independent predictors to build a combined model for high Ki-67 stratification. Receiver operating characteristic analysis evaluated diagnostic performance. The td-dMRI-derived microstructural parameters were validated against histopathologic measurements.
RESULTS: Significant differences in several td-dMRI parameters were observed between rNENs and RACs, as well as between groups with high and low Ki-67 expression. In the small rNEN cohort, td-dMRI parameters showed promising preliminary diagnostic performance in distinguishing rNEN from RAC (AUC = 0.882). For predicting high Ki-67 expression in RAC, the combined model yielded an AUC of 0.916 in the development cohort and 0.844 in the validation cohort. Microstructural parameters showed strong correlations with histopathology: cell diameter, cellularity, and intracellular volume fraction reached Pearson correlation coefficients (r) of 0.808, 0.773, and 0.765, respectively (all p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: Quantitative td-dMRI parameters may serve as a noninvasive tool for evaluating rectal tumor histological types (rNEN vs. RAC) and predicting Ki-67 expression in RAC.
papers.title_zh: 運用時間相依性擴散 MRI 定量參數，術前預測直腸腫瘤組織學類型與 Ki-67 表現
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：探討時間相依性擴散 MRI（td-dMRI）定量參數，在區分直腸神經內分泌腫瘤（rNEN）與直腸腺癌（RAC），以及區分 RAC 中高、低 Ki-67 表現的臨床價值。
材料與方法：這項雙中心研究於 2024 年 1 月至 2025 年 3 月前瞻性納入 90 名接受 td-dMRI 的直腸腫瘤患者，包括 85 名 RAC 患者（模型開發世代 n＝61、驗證世代 n＝24）及 5 名 rNEN 患者。使用 IMPULSED 模型估算 td-dMRI 衍生的微結構參數，並測量不同擴散時間下的表觀擴散係數（ADC）。使用 Firth 邏輯斯迴歸篩選與 rNEN 相關的參數，並以標準邏輯斯迴歸辨識獨立預測因子，建立用於高 Ki-67 表現分層的組合模型。透過接收者操作特徵曲線分析評估診斷效能，並以組織病理測量結果驗證 td-dMRI 衍生的微結構參數。
結果：rNEN 與 RAC 之間，以及高、低 Ki-67 表現組之間，多項 td-dMRI 參數均有顯著差異。在小型 rNEN 世代中，td-dMRI 參數在區分 rNEN 與 RAC 上呈現具潛力的初步診斷效能（AUC＝0.882）。在預測 RAC 高 Ki-67 表現方面，組合模型於開發世代的 AUC 為 0.916，於驗證世代為 0.844。微結構參數與組織病理測量結果呈高度相關：細胞直徑、細胞密度及細胞內體積分率的 Pearson 相關係數（r）分別為 0.808、0.773 及 0.765（皆 p＜0.001）。
結論：td-dMRI 定量參數可能作為非侵入性工具，用以評估直腸腫瘤的組織學類型（rNEN 與 RAC），並預測 RAC 的 Ki-67 表現。

papers.title: Tumor-microbe-microenvironment interactions and therapeutic implications for tumors with intratumoral microbes
papers.authors: Cao Y, Yue J, Ren Y
papers.abstract: The complex interactions between tumors and microbes within the tumor-microbe microenvironment (TMME) are increasingly recognized as critical determinants of tumor progression and therapeutic response. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the presence of intratumoral microbes (ITMs), their routes of entry into tumors, and their functional roles within the TMME, and highlights emerging TMME-targeted strategies for diagnosis and treatment of tumors with ITMs. ITMs can profoundly influence tumor biology by modulating cellular signaling and immune responses, with consequent changes in therapeutic efficacy. For instance, Fusobacterium nucleatum impairs CD8+ T-cell infiltration via succinic acid in drug-resistant colorectal cancer, while cytidine deaminase-expressing bacteria inactivate gemcitabine in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. We summarize the defining characteristics of the TMME, including hypoxia, acidity, and oxidative stress, as well as microbial-associated features such as biofilm formation, bacterial enzymes, and metabolite production. These factors collectively contribute to a dynamic ecosystem that supports microbial persistence and impacts tumor development, immune regulation, and treatment outcomes. Current therapeutic strategies targeting ITM tumors are critically evaluated, including microbial modulation approaches, non-antibiotic modalities, and nanomedicine-based co-delivery systems that combine antibiotics with chemotherapeutics. Co-delivery systems, such as a liposome platform that delivers ciprofloxacin and gemcitabine, allow simultaneous targeting of tumor cells and intratumoral microbes by exploiting the acidic, hypoxic, and enzyme- and metabolite-rich features of the TMME. This TMME-responsive design allows site-specific drug release while eliminating ITMs, and thereby overcomes microbe-induced chemoresistance and enhances therapeutic efficacy. Finally, we highlight the opportunities and challenges associated with TMME-targeted interventions. While modulation or elimination of tumor-associated microbes represents a promising strategy for improving treatment outcomes, significant barriers remain, including a lack of standardized diagnostic tools, microbial heterogeneity, safety concerns, and limited mechanistic understanding of tumor-microbe interactions. Advances in this field will require integrated multi-omics approaches and better translational models for the development of precise, personalized therapies for ITM tumors.
papers.title_zh: 腫瘤內含微生物之腫瘤的腫瘤—微生物—微環境交互作用與治療意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 腫瘤—微生物微環境（tumor-microbe microenvironment，TMME）中腫瘤與微生物之間的複雜交互作用，日益被認為是決定腫瘤進展與治療反應的關鍵因素。本綜述全面概述腫瘤內微生物（intratumoral microbes，ITMs）的存在、其進入腫瘤的途徑，以及其在 TMME 中的功能性角色，並重點介紹針對含有 ITMs 之腫瘤的新興 TMME 標靶診斷與治療策略。ITMs 可透過調節細胞訊息傳遞與免疫反應，深刻影響腫瘤生物學，進而改變治療效力。例如，在抗藥性大腸直腸癌中，具核梭桿菌（Fusobacterium nucleatum）會透過琥珀酸抑制 CD8+ T 細胞浸潤；而在胰管腺癌中，表現胞苷去胺酶的細菌會使 gemcitabine 失活。我們彙整 TMME 的主要特徵，包括缺氧、酸性與氧化壓力，以及生物膜形成、細菌酵素與代謝物生成等微生物相關特徵。這些因素共同形成一個動態生態系，支持微生物持續存在，並影響腫瘤發展、免疫調節與治療結果。本文批判性評估目前針對含有 ITMs 之腫瘤的治療策略，包括微生物調控方法、非抗生素治療方式，以及將抗生素與化學治療藥物結合的奈米醫學共同遞送系統。共同遞送系統，例如遞送 ciprofloxacin 與 gemcitabine 的脂質體平台，可利用 TMME 的酸性、缺氧，以及富含酵素與代謝物等特徵，同時標靶腫瘤細胞與腫瘤內微生物。這種對 TMME 產生反應的設計，可在清除 ITMs 的同時實現特定部位藥物釋放，從而克服微生物誘發的化學治療抗藥性，並提升治療效力。最後，我們重點說明 TMME 標靶介入的機會與挑戰。雖然調控或清除腫瘤相關微生物是改善治療結果的一項有前景策略，但仍存在重大障礙，包括缺乏標準化診斷工具、微生物異質性、安全性疑慮，以及對腫瘤—微生物交互作用機制的理解有限。此領域的進展將需要整合多體學方法與更完善的轉譯模型，以開發針對含有 ITMs 之腫瘤的精準個人化治療。

papers.title: Comparative Efficacy of Biologic Therapies for Psoriasis: Insights from Head-to-Head Studies
papers.authors: Rafałowicz A, Nowowiejska-Purpurowicz J, Flisiak I
papers.abstract: Biologic therapies have substantially transformed the management of moderate-to-severe psoriasis, but differences in efficacy, speed of response, durability, and safety reflect the distinct immunological pathways targeted by individual agents. The aim of this review is the analysis and comparison of particular biological agents in terms of efficacy and safety. Head-to-head trials consistently demonstrate that IL-17 and IL-23 inhibitors achieve greater skin clearance than first-generation TNF-α inhibitors. IL-17 blockade, particularly with agents targeting IL-17A, produces rapid clinical improvement by directly suppressing keratinocyte-driven inflammation. Dual IL-17A/IL-17F inhibition with bimekizumab may provide even greater clearance, although broader IL-17 inhibition is associated with a higher frequency of mucosal candidiasis. In contrast, selective IL-23 inhibition acts upstream by suppressing the differentiation and maintenance of pathogenic Th17 cells and appears to provide particularly durable disease control. Selective IL-23 inhibitors may also preserve potentially protective IL-12 signaling, distinguishing them from ustekinumab, which targets the shared p40 subunit. Safety profiles are generally favorable across biologic classes, although mechanism-specific risks include tuberculosis reactivation with TNF-α inhibitors, candidiasis with IL-17 inhibitors, and inflammatory bowel disease concerns with IL-17 blockade. Therefore, biologic selection should be individualized according to disease severity, required speed and durability of response, comorbidities, affected anatomical sites, safety considerations, dosing frequency, patient preferences and adherence goals. Current comparative evidence supports increasingly targeted approaches within the IL-23/IL-17 axis.

papers.title_zh: 乾癬生物製劑療效比較：來自頭對頭研究的見解
papers.abstract_zh: 生物製劑已大幅改變中重度乾癬的治療，但其療效、反應速度、持久性與安全性的差異，反映了各藥物所標靶的免疫路徑不同。本綜述旨在分析與比較特定生物製劑的療效及安全性。頭對頭試驗一致顯示，IL-17 與 IL-23 抑制劑的皮膚病灶清除效果優於第一代 TNF-α 抑制劑。阻斷 IL-17，尤其是使用標靶 IL-17A 的藥物，可直接抑制角質形成細胞驅動的發炎，帶來快速的臨床改善。以 bimekizumab 同時抑制 IL-17A／IL-17F，可能帶來更佳的病灶清除效果，但較廣泛地抑制 IL-17 與較高的黏膜念珠菌感染頻率有關。相較之下，選擇性抑制 IL-23 是透過抑制致病性 Th17 細胞的分化與維持，作用於較上游的環節，且似乎能提供特別持久的疾病控制。選擇性 IL-23 抑制劑也可能保留具有潛在保護作用的 IL-12 訊息傳遞，這點不同於標靶兩者共用之 p40 次單元的 ustekinumab。各類生物製劑的安全性整體而言良好，但機轉特異性的風險包括 TNF-α 抑制劑的結核病再活化、IL-17 抑制劑的念珠菌感染，以及阻斷 IL-17 所涉及的發炎性腸道疾病疑慮。因此，生物製劑的選擇應依疾病嚴重度、所需的反應速度與持久性、共病、受影響的解剖部位、安全性考量、給藥頻率、病人偏好及治療遵從性目標而個別化。目前的比較性證據支持在 IL-23／IL-17 軸上採取日益精準的標靶策略。
